Zazu works a 38-hour week and is paid at an hourly rate of \$45. Any overtime hours worked are paid at time-and-a-half.

In a particular week, Zazu worked the regular 38 hours and some overtime hours. In that week Zazu earned \$2790.

How many hours of overtime did Zazu work in that week?

solutions.latex:
Regular pay:
$$38 \times 45 = \$1710$$
Pay for overtime:
$$2790 - 1710 = \$1080$$
Time-and-a-half rate:
$$1.5 \times 45 = \$67.50 \text{ per hour}$$
Overtime hours:
$$\dfrac{1080}{67.50} = 16$$
$$\therefore\ \text{Zazu worked 16 hours of overtime.}$$
criteria: Finds the overtime rate and the overtime pay, or equivalent merit
Finds the regular pay of \$1710, or equivalent merit

Tian is paid \$20.45 per hour, as well as a meal allowance of \$16.20 per day.

What are Tian's total earnings if she works 9 hours per day for 5 days?

solutions.latex:
Earnings for one day are the hourly pay for 9 hours plus the meal allowance:
$$\begin{aligned} 9\times\$20.45+\$16.20&=\$184.05+\$16.20\\ &=\$200.25 \end{aligned}$$
For 5 days:
$$\begin{aligned} 5\times\$200.25&=\$1001.25 \end{aligned}$$
So the answer is option C.

A real estate agent's commission for selling houses is $2\%$ for the first \$800 000 of the sale price and $1.5\%$ for any amount over \$800 000.

Calculate the commission earned in selling a house for \$1 500 000.

solutions.latex:
The commission is $2\%$ of the first $\$800\,000$ plus $1.5\%$ of the amount over $\$800\,000$.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Commission} &= 0.02 \times 800\,000 + 0.015 \times (1\,500\,000 - 800\,000) \\ &= 0.02 \times 800\,000 + 0.015 \times 700\,000 \\ &= \$26\,500 \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Calculates a correct percentage, or equivalent merit
